cln_ai_models_init_desc:
To use advanced AI classification and face recognition, CLIP and InsightFace models (~1.5 GB) are required.
This download is done once, and then the AI runs completely offline.
cln_ai_info_tooltip:
🧠 HOW AI SEARCH WORKS:

1. Analysis Types:
   • General Similarity: Compares colors, composition, and objects using OpenAI CLIP (ViT-B/32).
   • Face Recognition: Detects human faces and matches facial features using InsightFace.

2. Number of Reference Images:
   • For Faces: 1-3 clear photos from different angles are enough.
   • For General: 2-5 typical screenshots or images.

3. Similarity Threshold (Confidence):
   • 85% - 100%: Strict match (same person, nearly identical screenshots).
   • 70% - 85%: Moderate similarity (same person in other clothes, similar scenes).
   • 50% - 70%: Broad search (similar colors and structure).

💡 Tip: Use clear examples and disable unnecessary Reference Groups for best results.

cln_ai_tags_help_body:
Complex Search Queries (Multi-tags):
You can enter complex queries directly into the search bar using square brackets and a colon.
Syntax: [Header: query 1, query 2, ...]
Example: query [Pets: cat, dog, parrot] creates a single result group named 'Pets' containing all 3 types of animals.

Individual Parameter Thresholds (number):
You can fine-tune the match threshold for any specific word by appending a number in round brackets (no space).
Positive example: girl(80) — passes if similarity is ≥ 80%. (Higher = stricter filtering).
Negative example (tolerance): -boy(50) — drops the image if similarity is ≥ 50%. (Lower = stricter filtering).

Saved Tags System:
Tags are convenient bookmarks for your frequent queries.
The tag header sets the name of the result group for the search:
• For a single tag (e.g., 'Dog') — the group will have the same name.
• For a multi-tag — the tag header becomes the group name for multiple queries.

You can combine plain text in the search bar with selected tags. Each individual tag or query creates its own independent result column.
cln_ai_quick_filter_tip:
Hides files from the table whose similarity with the group leader is below the selected percentage.
This does NOT delete files permanently, but temporarily hides them,
helping you focus only on the closest matches.
